items.title: Persistent memory for eve agents
items.snippet: eve agents can now retain context across sessions and use it in future conversations. Persistent memory is organized into slots. You can define named slots in files under agent/memory/ . Each slot specifies a provider, which stores and retrieves the memory, and a scope, which determines who or what shares it.
